inputs.text: The “routine policy” story is cover. Bill C-12 receiving royal assent on March 26, 2026, gives the tightening a respectable legal wrapper, and the reassuring title—“Strengthening Canada’s Immigration System and Borders Act”—helps sell expanded control as protection. Singling out Nigerians and others makes it easier to test public acceptance of restrictions while presenting the whole push as neutral security administration. The timing and framing look coordinated, not accidental.
